predictions.articleTitle: Zwaluwen vs Blauw Geel Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Can Home Control Break Parity?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Zwaluwen's superior points efficiency and disciplined 1:0 home blueprint favor the hosts to avoid defeat, while a near-zero goal-expectancy gap makes Home Win / Draw under 2.5 goals the most coherent projection.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win / Draw captures Zwaluwen's home clean-sheet edge alongside Blauw Geel's 1.33 goals-per-game scoring parity (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 total goals aligns with five straight low-scoring home fixtures for Zwaluwen in league and cup play (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

spf.comment: Covers both the primary 1:0 Zwaluwen home-control script and the 1:1 stalemate branch, because a 0.05 goal-expectancy gap and zero home goal difference make a single win call too exposed.

score.comment: 1:0 reflects Zwaluwen's repeated home league winning template, while 1:1 is the top Poisson baseline scoreline if Blauw Geel match their 1.33 goals-per-match rate.
